env_allowlist.PATH: runner-provided local Python and Git command discovery

network_enforcement: The structural negative release checker reads only repository-local files, hashes, and Git state and makes no network request. It deliberately does not repair, fetch, build, or mutate the incomplete automation-provided .lake artifact.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact seven-line negative release summary ending verdict=blocked audit_complete=false theorem_complete=false

scope_boundary: Reconciles the current structured authority, frozen denominator, provisional proof and validation receipts, false frozen composition interface, release evidence requirements, and current missing pinned artifact. Historical Lean results are hash-bound but not rerun or promoted. The recipe creates no accepted state, M0/E0/E1 credit, AUDIT-Z, THEOREM-Z, release, theorem completion, or master acceptance.
